arrivalEssentials: San Francisco rewards a little arrival planning, especially if you are heading into the city at peak traffic times.
Decide whether BART, rideshare, or taxi is the fastest airport exit for your arrival time and luggage load.
Keep a contactless card or mobile wallet ready for transit, food, and quick backup payments.
If you are landing late, confirm hotel check-in timing and your first transfer before leaving the terminal.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: If you are arriving from overseas, check the current US entry requirement that applies to your passport and visa or ESTA status.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: Carry the right US travel authorization before departure; permission to enter is still decided by border officers on arrival.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: Follow the live arrival and customs instructions provided by your airline and US border agencies for your route.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Use official US government travel and border sources for current entry instructions.
importantNotes: International arrival procedures can take longer than expected during busy periods, so avoid tight onward plans.
Keep your first-night address, return or onward details, and key booking confirmations easy to show if asked.

handyPhrases.context: Useful the moment you leave the terminal if you are taking rail into the city.
Helpful for transit, cafes, and quick casual purchases.
Easy shorthand when checking rideshare drop-offs or asking for direction.

businessEtiquette.summary: San Francisco business settings usually reward directness, punctuality, and a conversational tone that still gets to the point.
tips: Confirm timing and exact meeting location because neighbourhood-to-neighbourhood travel can take longer than it looks on a map.
A smart-casual presentation is common in many tech and creative settings unless the host signals otherwise.
Keep introductions warm but concise, and move to the practical agenda fairly quickly.
Follow up with concrete next steps rather than assuming verbal alignment is enough.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Tap water is generally safe to drink.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is commonly expected in restaurants, bars, and many service settings.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and health-focused options are easy to find in most central areas.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Coffee shops, casual counters, and neighbourhood spots can get busy early, so mobile ordering helps when time is tight.
usefulPhrases: Can I get this to go?
Where should I catch the rideshare?

moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards and mobile wallets are widely accepted across most of the city.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Carry only a small amount of cash for edge cases or backup needs.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Expect to tip in seated dining and many service interactions unless the bill clearly includes service.
